rationale: The recovered Laravel service preserves canonical GetAsync read/fallback behavior while adapting desktop application settings to the existing tenant-scoped site settings store. Site resolution is tenant-scoped before persistence access, the settings query repeats tenant and site authority, malformed or absent persisted values fail safe to source-equivalent defaults, and persisted site_id cannot override the authoritative tenant-owned Site model. The already-integrated SaveAsync implementation remains unchanged in behavior and ownership.

runtime_behavior.persistence: tenant-scoped scoped_settings row with scope=site, key=site_brain.profile, site_key=site:{site_id}, is_secret=false
runtime_behavior.stored_profile: known typed fields are normalized onto source defaults and authoritative site_id is restored from the tenant-scoped Site model

security.authorization: read operation requires an active tenant context and tenant-owned Site resolution; no mutating settings.manage grant is introduced for canonical read parity
security.tenant_isolation: foreign-tenant site ID raises ModelNotFoundException before scoped_settings access
security.persistence_scope: tenant_id + site scope + authoritative site_key + canonical setting key + non-secret row

acceptance: canonical operation identity, source member, read-only semantics, and default-profile source are pinned to AIMW-AI-0F3763FDB4
missing profile returns the source-equivalent SiteBrain defaults with server UTC updated_at_utc
valid tenant/site scoped persisted JSON is read without trusting a stored site_id
blank, malformed, and non-object persisted values fail safe to defaults
foreign-tenant site lookup fails closed with ModelNotFoundException
existing AIMW-AI-34EC6312B9 SaveAsync implementation remains present and independently terminal
